newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers PLN 600 mln 3-yr bonds on October 22.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers PLN 600 mln 3-yr bonds on October 22.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry offered 600 million zlotys of variable-interest three-year bonds at a tender for institutional investors on October 22, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said the bonds, maturing November 6, 1999, were part of a 1.1 billion zloty tranch, the rest of which will be offered to the public in November 1996.

The quarterly coupon of the three-year bond is five basis points above the arithmetical average of the average weighted yields of 13-week T-bills from four consecutive auctions in the month before the coupon payment.
